author: CMLSC
body:
This is my first map! (I've been wanting to make one for years) It features something that I see missing in a lot of maps... The ability to easily make tunnels! :D
The map also contains various resources that allow you to make things such as pistons and powered rails! ^_^
NOTE: I edited the map based on the recommendations from this post. I did not change the palette, but I made it wider, and changed a couple other things.


Map Name: Wasted (I couldn't think of a better one. X3)

Map Creator: CMLSC

Map Download: I had a download, but I'll wait since I keep having to change the map.

YAML: http://pastebin.com/dSPbTXvZ
WARNING: I may have messed up the YAML. I just looked at someone else's and tried to modify it to make it work for mine. :P

Newest Version:


Images from here on are basically the same, except the chest now contains a few slime blocks(:3), the map is wider, and the bridges were removed.
At first glance, it looks like a standard map:

Ignore the message in the chat. XD I made this on my server, so i would have access to world edit. X3

The floor is specifically made out of sandstone so it will be easy to tunnel through!

This platform is made to encourage players to make pathways below the map, which is rarely done although it is a good tactic. There are stairs in the middle that connect to the upper half.


There are multiple spots to shoot from to help defend:


There is also a tunnel going up through this area that helps players sneak by:

There are thin sandstone pathways(that can easily be destroyed for a better defense) to the monuments to encourage players to go and protect the monument.


There is redstone in the chest. Since there is gold on the bottom and iron on the top, railroads can be made to transport the players toward the end of the game.


There are two beacons in the middle which can be taken back to the iron stack and used to add haste. There are also diamonds to get the players to try to get to the middle. Which will cause the two sides to link very early in the game. Each side is 33 blocks from the other. The middle island is even easier to get to.

And that's my map! :D
Please tell me what you think!
~CMLSC
